title: The Price of an Empty Delivery Truck
fact_notes: 人物・制度・具体的な出来事は架空の教材例・思考実験。実在の調査・統計・実証結果を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A fictional group of small businesses in a rural district considered sharing a delivery service for customers living far from their shops.
sentences.ja: 架空の農村地域の小規模事業者は店から離れた顧客向け配送サービスの共有を検討した。

sentences.en: Each shop initially calculated its delivery fee by dividing the cost of a journey by the number of packages carried on that particular trip.
sentences.ja: 各店は当初、移動費をその便で運ぶ荷物数で割り配送料を算出した。

sentences.en: The calculation seemed reasonable when the vehicles were full, but the fee became unexpectedly high whenever only a few orders were available.
sentences.ja: 車両が満載なら合理的に見えたが注文が少ないと料金が予想外に高くなった。

sentences.en: The owners wondered whether cooperation could reduce these fluctuations without requiring every customer to accept an identical delivery schedule.
sentences.ja: 協力により全顧客に同じ配送日程を強いず変動を減らせるか考えた。

sentences.en: One proposal was to combine packages from several shops on a single vehicle whenever their destinations were located in the same direction.
sentences.ja: 複数店舗の荷物を目的地が同方向の場合一台にまとめる案があった。

sentences.en: However, the owners recognized that coordinating orders would involve additional administrative work and might delay certain deliveries.
sentences.ja: しかし注文調整には追加事務作業が伴い一部の配送が遅れるかもしれないと認識した。

sentences.en: A customer who needed an urgent replacement for a damaged item might not benefit from waiting until enough other orders had accumulated.
sentences.ja: 壊れた品の緊急交換が必要な顧客は他の注文が十分集まるまで待っても利益を得ないかもしれない。

sentences.en: The group therefore distinguished between flexible deliveries and requests that required more immediate attention.
sentences.ja: そこで柔軟な配送とより迅速な対応が必要な依頼を区別した。

sentences.en: During a limited trial, the businesses offered customers a choice between scheduled shared deliveries and separate arrangements at a clearly stated additional cost.
sentences.ja: 限定的な試行で共同配送便と明示された追加費用での個別配送を顧客に選んでもらった。

sentences.en: They recorded the time spent organizing journeys as well as the expenses directly associated with operating the vehicles.
sentences.ja: 車両の運行に直接関係する費用だけでなく便の調整時間も記録した。

sentences.en: The owners also agreed on a procedure for sharing costs when one business supplied a much greater proportion of the packages than the others.
sentences.ja: 一店が他より大幅に多くの荷物を出した場合の費用分担手順も合意した。

sentences.en: These records helped them evaluate the arrangement without assuming that cooperation would automatically produce savings in every situation.
sentences.ja: 記録は協力があらゆる状況で自動的に節約を生むと仮定せず仕組みを評価する助けになった。

sentences.en: The trial revealed that several customers were willing to wait for a scheduled delivery when the expected date and price were communicated clearly.
sentences.ja: 試行では予定日と料金が明確に伝えられると共同配送を待つ顧客が数人いると分かった。

sentences.en: Other customers continued to prefer individual arrangements because the timing of their orders was less predictable.
sentences.ja: 注文時期が予測しにくいため個別配送を好み続ける顧客もいた。

sentences.en: Rather than replacing all existing services, the owners decided to maintain a combination of options suited to different needs.
sentences.ja: 既存サービスをすべて置き換えず異なる必要に合う選択肢の組み合わせを維持することにした。

sentences.en: They agreed to review the cost-sharing system regularly as the number and geographical distribution of orders changed.
sentences.ja: 注文数や地理的分布が変わるにつれ費用分担を定期的に見直すことにした。

sentences.en: The example illustrates that cooperation can create value by making more effective use of limited resources, but it also creates new obligations.
sentences.ja: この例は協力が限られた資源の効率利用で価値を生む一方、新しい責務も生むことを示す。

sentences.en: A lower delivery fee is not necessarily an improvement if it depends on unreasonable delays or distributes expenses unfairly among participants.
sentences.ja: 不合理な遅延や不公平な費用分担に依存するなら低料金は必ずしも改善ではない。

sentences.en: Business decisions therefore require attention to the conditions under which apparent savings are achieved.
sentences.ja: 事業判断には見かけの節約が達成される条件への注意が必要である。

sentences.en: The owners learned that the most useful question was not simply how to fill a truck, but how to design an arrangement that customers and businesses could reasonably sustain.
sentences.ja: 最も有用な問いは単に車を満載にすることではなく顧客と事業者が合理的に維持できる仕組みをどう設計するかだと学んだ。

vocabulary.definition: something used in place of another

questions.prompt: How did shops originally calculate fees?
options: Multiply price by number of shops.
Divide trip cost by number of packages.
questions.explanation_ja: 便の費用を荷物数で割る。

options: Every customer paid a fixed annual fee.
The number of packages per trip varied.

questions.prompt: What was the initial cooperation proposal?
options: Combine deliveries going in the same direction.
questions.explanation_ja: 同方向の配送をまとめる。

options: Waiting for other orders may be unsuitable for urgent needs.
Scheduled shared delivery or separate delivery at extra cost.
A choice between two unrelated goods.

questions.prompt: What did the businesses record besides vehicle expenses?
options: The cost of painting the shops.
Different customers had different timing needs.
As order volume and geographical distribution changed.
Whenever a customer bought a chair.
A full truck always means a successful service.
Cooperative savings must be assessed alongside delays, coordination and fairness.
Low fees should be the only measure.
questions.explanation_ja: 節約と負担・公平性を検討。

grammar.focus: whenever only a few orders were available
if it depends on unreasonable delays

paraphrases.source: The calculation seemed reasonable when the vehicles were full, but the fee became unexpectedly high whenever only a few orders were available.
paraphrases.rewrite: Fees rose unexpectedly on trips carrying few orders.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 注文が少ないと料金が高い。

paraphrases.source: A customer who needed an urgent replacement for a damaged item might not benefit from waiting until enough other orders had accumulated.
paraphrases.rewrite: An urgent customer could be disadvantaged by waiting for a shared load.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 急ぎの場合共同便が不適切。

paraphrases.source: They recorded the time spent organizing journeys as well as the expenses directly associated with operating the vehicles.
paraphrases.rewrite: They recorded both coordination time and vehicle operating costs.

paraphrases.source: A lower delivery fee is not necessarily an improvement if it depends on unreasonable delays or distributes expenses unfairly among participants.
paraphrases.rewrite: A cheaper service is not automatically better if it causes excessive delays or unfair cost allocation.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 安さは常に改善ではない。

discourse.role_ja: 満載時と少量時の対比。
全面置換ではなく選択肢併存。
